text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Banks will cut interest rates by one percentage point starting July 1. The cut will bring interest rates down to a 14.0-18.5 percent range from the current 15.0-19.5 percent.
- Prime Minister Ahmed Ouyahia, campaigning for a seat in the National Assembly, tells an artists' meeting the government has cancelled a decision to pension off artists at the age of 60.
- Salah Boubnider, head of the national election watchdog, says campaigning unfolding smoothly.
- Twenty-five European states bar France accept to send officials to oversee the Algerian election to be held on June 5. A total of 200 foreign observers are expected to watch the poll.
- Algerians are yearning for true debates on television on campaign issues.
